text.en:
1. This Order may be cited as the Members of Parliament
(Remuneration) (Amendment of First Schedule) Order 1981 and
shall be deemed to have come into force on the 9th June 1981.

2. The First Schedule to the Members of Parliament (Remunera-
tion) Act 1980 is amended—

(a) by substituting for subparagraph (2) of paragraph 3 the
following subparagraph (2):
"(2) Notwithstanding subparagraph (2) of para-
graph 2—

(a) in the case of a person who has held the office
of Prime Minister and where the length of his
reckonable service is 36 months or less, the
monthly pension payable under subparagraph (2)
of paragraph 2 shall be that sum computed on
the basis of 36 months reckonable service or
three thousand ringgit, whichever is the greater;
and
